g4ela-32-1-morphology: You know more roots than you think. Some you haven’t used yet. Try putting them to work: press means push, tain means hold, lev means lift. Find a word with one of them and use it in your own writing.
g4ela-32-2-grammar: Proofread like an editor. Read slowly, one sentence at a time. Check capitals, then usage, then punctuation, then spelling. Four quick passes catch more than one long one.
g4ela-32-3-spelling: One last spelling check. Read your piece out loud and touch each long word. Find the part you know. Check the ending. If a word looks strange, it probably is. Fix it now, and your best piece stays your best.
g4ela-32-4-grammar: Your final sentence deserves your best care. Capital at the start. A complete thought. The right mark at the end. Read it out loud. If it sounds like you, it’s ready.
